title: Megurine Luka — Happy Anniversary!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone.
Thank you all for joining me to celebrate my anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And hello as well to everyone watching the stream. Can you all hear me okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow! Look at all the comments!
There are so many!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
“Congratulations, Luka.
I couldn't be there live, but I'll be watching your stream.”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I want our viewers to have just as much fun, so we'll try to get to as many comments as we can.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And of course, we'll be singing plenty of songs for you. We all practiced quite a bit for this, you know?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. As a reward for sending me such wonderful comments, let's get right to it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll start things off with a little duet!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Luka, Miku, great start!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. I like how you're just your usual self, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If I were in your shoes, I'd be bouncing off the walks from having too much fun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's one of your best qualities, Len, just like how Luka's able to just be her usual self.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
It may not be that evident, but I am very excited about today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, so many people have gathered here to celebrate with us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, your tempo was a tiny bit quicker than normal during the dance for the chorus just now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm not sure I've ever seen you feel rushed or anxious at all for anything.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? It happens more often than you think...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, let's put that to the test!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Test? How...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Boo!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Well, so much for my little scare test...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You were totally unfazed by that, huh, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I was plenty surprised.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Just look at the comments.
<Luka's so cute when she's surprised.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! I couldn't tell at all!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... That just means I'll have to prepare something better to really bring your emotions to the surface.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But not too good, alright?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: For our next song, Len, you won't get to see my surprised face, but you will get to see me smile!
song00002_off_f

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll be joining you for this one♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Everyone, it's time to get really pumped! Let's give Luka the celebration she really deserves!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Unfortunately, our next song will be our last. Time really flies when you're having fun...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know, right...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But before that, Luka, we have some special messages for you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Luka!
You being so calm and collected even during the worst of times has been so big for all of us.
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I also really like it when you're sort of just staring into space, and I'm hoping we all get to see more of that side of you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. I love how you're like a soft and fluffy pillow, Luka! And it's so cool whenever you sing in English!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, you have this amazing knack for singing fun songs... I love every part of you, so I hope we get to do lots and lots more stuff together!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Luka!
Remember what you said during my anniversary? How you were wondering what it'd be like to get pranked?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I was really hoping to surprise you somehow today, but I'm gonna think of something for next time that really gets a good reaction out of you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Luka!
You said before that I'm a very reliable person...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I rely on you quite a bit too, you know? My hope is that we can keep being friends who give each other mutual support!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Great show so far, Luka.
Your talent for creating an atmosphere that matches each song really shined through today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And singing with you always ends up being a wonderful experience, so I'm hoping we get more opportunities to do this moving forward!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, one last time!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's so beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Miku, Rin, Len, MEIKO, KAITO.
Thank you, all of you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm able to do things at my own pace because I have all of you there beside me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You all make up for the things I'm not able to do, so I'd like it if I could do the same for all of you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because it's so wonderful when we're all here to give each other support.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And I promise to do everything I can to maintain what we've achieved.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To all those who joined me in person, as well as those watching the stream, thank you for today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'll do my best to make this upcoming year another great one, so I'll be looking forward to your continued support♪
